clue.text: Witch goes outside with book carrier

indicators.note: the witch word goes outside, wrapping around the next two pieces

parts.note: a hag is an ugly old woman or witch
with means and, joining things

explanation.surface: A witch heads out of doors with a book under her arm.
explanation.definitionFit: A bag for carrying a woman's purse, keys and phone is a carrier in the plainest sense.

clue.text: Somewhere to cook old tramp

parts.note: a hob is a cooking surface on a stove

explanation.surface: An old tramp needs a place to cook.
explanation.definitionFit: An American word for a homeless wanderer, synonymous with tramp or vagrant.

clue.text: Adrenaline rising for some boring specialist

indicators.note: rising in a down clue means the letters read upwards, in reverse
for some means only a portion of the word is taken

explanation.surface: A dull expert gets an adrenaline rush.
explanation.definitionFit: A dull person obsessed with a technical subject is a boring specialist.

clue.text: A born liar deviously gives nothing away to a cricketer

indicators.note: deviously means the letters are moved by underhand twists
gives ... away signals that something is surrendered from the fodder
away completes the instruction to give up a letter

parts.note: O is zero, nothing

explanation.surface: A dishonest type ditches nothing to become a cricketer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'gives ... away' drops O from A BORN LIAR; 'deviously' turns the rest into BRIANLAR, then the second 'a' follows. Brian Lara is the great West Indian batsman.
explanation.definitionFit: The West Indies batsman who holds Test cricket's highest individual score is a famous cricketer.

clue.text: Understood Erik, possibly understated?

parts.note: read as under-stated: put below a state, here GA, the abbreviation for Georgia
Erik the Red, the Viking explorer, is one example of someone given that nickname

explanation.surface: Was Erik, who may have been underplayed, understood?
explanation.walkthrough: 'understated' splits into 'under' and 'stated': in a down clue THE RED (Erik's nickname) goes under a state, GA for Georgia.
explanation.definitionFit: To have gathered something is to have inferred or understood it from what was said.

clue.text: USA's let off gun's part of 21 in these

definitions.note: a gun's chamber holds the blank rounds fired in ceremonial gun salutes

indicators.note: off signals the letters are thrown off their proper order, like a gun going off

explanation.surface: The United States has fired off a gun, as nations do on ceremonial days.
explanation.walkthrough: 21 is CHAMBER MUSIC; the part of it that belongs to a gun is the chamber, where the round sits when ceremonial volleys are fired.
explanation.definitionFit: Ceremonial volleys of blank rounds honour visiting dignitaries, each round loaded into the gun's chamber.

clue.text: Vigorously push across river on a Tuesday

definitions.note: describes one particular Tuesday, the day before Ash Wednesday

indicators.note: across means the push word stretches across, enclosing the river letter

parts.note: to shove is to push hard

explanation.surface: Someone shoves hard to get across a river one Tuesday.
explanation.walkthrough: The adjective is only used of one Tuesday, the eve of Lent, when pancakes are eaten.
explanation.definitionFit: The adjective applied to Pancake Day, the day before Lent begins, naming a particular Tuesday.

clue.text: Short bit of poetry about cheerful flower

indicators.note: about means the trimmed verse word goes around the cheerful word
short means the last letter of the verse word is dropped

parts.note: a line is a single bit of a poem
up means in good spirits

explanation.surface: A brief verse about a happy bloom.
explanation.definitionFit: A garden plant with tall spikes of pea-like blooms is a flower.

clue.text: Film terrible art with no merit

indicators.note: terrible means the letters are mangled into a new order

explanation.surface: A review of a film: dreadful art, entirely without merit.
explanation.walkthrough: The anagram pools ART and NO MERIT; the film is the 1984 James Cameron science-fiction picture.
explanation.definitionFit: A 1984 science-fiction movie starring Arnold Schwarzenegger as a killer cyborg.

clue.text: Someone vacantly making tears over a way of making part of 21

definitions.note: singing to a loved one is one way of making music

indicators.note: vacantly means the word is emptied of its inside letters
over means the tearing word goes over, covering the single letter

parts.note: rending means tearing

explanation.surface: Someone with a blank look is in tears over a way of making music.
explanation.walkthrough: 'making tears' looks like weeping, but tears here rhymes with bears: rending.
explanation.definitionFit: Singing or playing under a beloved's window is one particular way of making music.

clue.text: Knight comes back to exchange cases for one in parts of 21

definitions.note: lawyers at the Bar work from sets of offices called chambers

indicators.note: cases is a verb here: the exchange word encases the returning knight

parts.note: to barter is to exchange goods

indicators.note: comes back means the knight's title is read in reverse order

parts.note: Sir is the title of a knight

explanation.surface: A knight returns to swap cases with someone in another room.
explanation.walkthrough: 'parts of 21' are chambers: English advocates practise from barristers' chambers.
explanation.definitionFit: Advocates at the English Bar practise from shared offices traditionally called chambers, so one of them is someone in chambers.

clue.text: Express satisfaction about Spain being less polluted

indicators.note: about means going round, so the contented sound goes around the country letter

parts.note: a cat purrs to express satisfaction
E is the international vehicle code for Spain (España)

explanation.surface: Someone is pleased that Spain has become cleaner.
explanation.definitionFit: Comparative of pure: something cleaner or with fewer contaminants is less polluted.

clue.text: New idea covers short-term mediation

indicators.note: covers means the idea word wraps around the clipped word

parts.note: an invention is a new idea or contrivance

indicators.note: short means the final letter of the word term is cut off

parts.note: taken as written before being clipped

explanation.surface: A fresh concept takes in short-term mediation, like a policy paper.
explanation.walkthrough: 'short-term' looks like one compound adjective, but the hyphen hides two jobs: 'short' is the clipping instruction acting on the word beside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Stepping in to settle a dispute between others is a form of intercession or mediation.

clue.text: Nuclear facilities include French telescopes

indicators.note: include means the plant word takes the abbreviation inside it

parts.note: reactors are nuclear facilities

explanation.surface: French atomic power stations have observatories.
explanation.definitionFit: Lens-based instruments that bend light to magnify distant objects are a class of telescopes.

clue.text: Sauron aspired to be such a circus performer

definitions.text: Sauron aspired to be such a circus performer

parts.words: Sauron aspired to be such a circus performer
parts.note: Tolkien's Dark Lord wanted to control the One Ring, so he was a would-be master of the ring; the circus figure presides over the ring

explanation.surface: Tolkien's villain secretly wanted to run away and join the circus.
explanation.definitionFit: The figure who presides over performances in the big top is a circus performer in charge of the ring.

clue.text: Stadium space one assesses

parts.note: an em is a printer's unit of space
I is the Roman numeral for one
to rate something is to assess or value it

explanation.surface: A stadium's space is something one assesses, as a surveyor might.
explanation.walkthrough: The Emirates is Arsenal's football ground in north London.
explanation.definitionFit: Arsenal Football Club plays home matches at a north London ground named after its airline sponsor.

clue.text: Mission Darren messed up

indicators.note: messed up means the letters of the name are jumbled

explanation.surface: Darren bungled the job he was sent to do.
explanation.definitionFit: A task one is sent out to do, often a small one, is a mission in a modest sense.

clue.text: Second hearing about a couple of events being brought back

indicators.note: about means the hearing word goes round the two letters

parts.note: a retrial is a second hearing of a case

indicators.note: a couple of means only the opening two letters of events are taken

explanation.surface: A case is reheard concerning two incidents being returned.
explanation.definitionFit: Getting something back or recovering it is the act of it being brought back.

clue.text: Quiet Hardy showed indifference

parts.note: sh is a call for quiet
hardy means tough, rugged

explanation.surface: A taciturn Hardy, perhaps the novelist, did not care.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hardy' looks like the novelist Thomas Hardy; it is the adjective.
explanation.definitionFit: Raising and dropping the shoulders is the gesture of someone who showed indifference.

clue.text: Part of 21, say, in terrible rage

definitions.note: 21 is music for small groups; this Jamaican style is a part of music generally

indicators.note: in places the example abbreviation within the shuffled letters
terrible signals the letters of rage are mangled

parts.note: e.g. (for example) is signalled by say

explanation.surface: A burst of chamber-music fury, so to speak, inside a terrible rage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Part of 21' points at MUSIC, the second word of 21 (CHAMBER MUSIC), and the Jamaican genre is one kind.
explanation.definitionFit: A Jamaican popular style with offbeat rhythms is one genre within music as a whole.

clue.text: Demonstrated about posh Irish politician getting power taken away

indicators.note: about means the demonstrated word goes around the other two pieces

parts.note: to have shown something is to have demonstrated it
U means upper-class, as in U and non-U
a TD (Teachta Dala) is a member of the Irish parliament

explanation.surface: A grand Irish politician protested as the electricity was cut off.
explanation.definitionFit: A complete stop of a plant or system, as when the electricity supply is cut, is power taken away.

clue.text: Supporter of the monarch who composed 21

parts.note: a bra is a supporting undergarment
HM is His or Her Majesty, the monarch; with 's it is possessive

explanation.surface: A loyal supporter of the king who wrote chamber pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: The German Romantic composer wrote much chamber music, including quintets and sonatas.

clue.text: Warning signal before problem returns during fashionable entertainment

indicators.note: during means the signal and the problem sit within the stylish word

parts.note: chic means stylish or fashionable

indicators.note: before places the light colour ahead of the problem

parts.note: amber is the warning light on traffic signals

indicators.note: returns means the problem word is read backwards

parts.note: a sum is an arithmetic problem

explanation.surface: A traffic warning precedes trouble coming back at a stylish party.
explanation.definitionFit: Music for a small ensemble played in a room is a form of entertainment.

clue.text: Steep climb ending next to empty house

indicators.note: ending means only the final letter of climb is taken

parts.note: at means beside, next to

indicators.note: empty means the inside of the word is removed

explanation.surface: A steep climb ends beside a vacant house.
explanation.definitionFit: To steep something is to soak or immerse it in liquid, as when one bathes it.

clue.text: Second ear to put in gun's part of 21

definitions.text: to put in gun's part of 21
definitions.note: a gun's chamber holds the round; this is something to load into it

parts.note: lug is a slang word for an ear

explanation.surface: Ammunition for a gun is described oddly in terms of ears.
explanation.walkthrough: 21 is CHAMBER MUSIC; the gun's part of it is the chamber, where a bullet goes.
explanation.definitionFit: Slang for a bullet, the projectile loaded into a firearm's chamber.

clue.text: Left part of 21

indicators.note: part of means only a stretch inside the number, spelt out in words, is taken

parts.note: the number written out in full is twenty-one, and the letters are read from that spelling

explanation.surface: Someone walked out partway through some chamber music.
explanation.walkthrough: Every other 'part of 21' in this puzzle means part of CHAMBER MUSIC; here 21 is just the number, spelt twenty-one, with the answer inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Went is the past tense of go, so someone who went has departed or left.

clue.text: Company backing offensive 21?

indicators.note: backing means the company abbreviation goes in reverse

parts.note: the Tet Offensive was the 1968 Vietnamese attack

clue.text: Raised rejection of Brussels facilities as being worth a lot

parts.note: raised means high, lifted up

indicators.note: rejection here is a throwing back, so the following pieces are read in reverse

parts.note: Brussels is the seat of the EU
lav is short for lavatory, the facilities

explanation.surface: Raising Brexit-style refusal of Brussels toilets as costly.
explanation.definitionFit: Something with a great price or importance attached is worth a lot.

clue.text: County's carriages

definitions.meaning: Surrey is a county south-west of London; with 's it is the county's
a surrey is a light four-wheeled horse-drawn carriage

explanation.surface: The carriages belonging to a county.
explanation.definitionFit: Both a home county south of London and a light horse-drawn carriage, with the 's serving as possessive or plural.

clue.text: Please reduce illumination?

definitions.meaning: to please someone is to give them joy
read as ..., taking away light, a whimsical coinage

explanation.surface: A polite request to dim the lights.
explanation.definitionFit: To gratify someone greatly is to please them; the question mark flags the invented de-light sense.
